Home.eyebrow: Izilimi ezingu-80 · imibuzo ebhalwe ubuhlakani bokwenziwa · mahhala
Home.lifelinesSubtitle: Uma usubambekile, usizo lungasindisa umdlalo wakho. Zisebenzise ngokuhlakanipha — imibuzo enzima kakhulu iza ekugcineni.
Home.howStep1Body: Imibuzo ibhalelwe ulimi lwakho namasiko akho, ayihunyushiwe.
Home.howStep2Body: Khetha u-A, u-B, u-C noma u-D, bese uqinisekisa impendulo yakho yokugcina.
Home.howStep3Body: 50:50, Buza izethameli, Shayela umngane, Shintsha umbuzo.
Home.howStep4Body: Ungahamba nemali yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi — noma ubeke konke engcupheni ngenxa yesigidi.
Home.leaderboardSubtitle: Imidlalo emihle kakhulu yeMarathoni noMjaho Nesikhathi evela kubadlali emhlabeni wonke.
Home.emptyLeaderboard: Ayikabi bikho imidlalo yokuqhudelana — yiba ngowokuqala!
Home.cultureBody: Umbhali wethu wemibuzo osebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa udala imibuzo emisha ngqo ngolimi ngalunye kwezilimi ezingu-80, exuba ulwazi lomhlaba nomlando, imibhalo, ijografi namasiko akini. Umbuzo ngembongi oyithandayo ngeke ube ukuhunyushwa kombuzo omayelana nomunye umuntu.
Home.offlineBody: Faka i-app bese uqhubeka nokudlala Okwakudala endizeni noma esitimeleni: imibuzo ngolimi lwakho igcinwa kudivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Amaphuzu akho azovumelaniswa uma usubuyele ku-inthanethi.
Home.badgesSubtitle: Fika eziphephelweni, uwine isigidi, udlale nsuku zonke ungayeki — kukhona amabheji angu-{count} ongawazuza.
Home.categoriesSubtitle: Kusukela emlandweni nesayensi kuya kumafilimu, ukudla namasiko akini.
Home.faq1Answer: Yebo. Zonke izindlela zokudlala, zonke izilimi nazo zonke izinsizo kumahhala, futhi akudingeki ubhalise ukuze udlale Okwakudala.
Home.faq2Answer: Umbhali wemibuzo osebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa uyibhala ngqo ngolimi lwakho, futhi umbuzo ngamunye uhlolwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphambi kokuthi ufike emdlalweni. Uma kukhona okungalungile okudlulayo, ungakubika ngokuthinta kanye.
Home.faq3Answer: Ukuphendula kahle umbuzo 5 kukuqinisekisela {havenOne}, umbuzo 10 ukuqinisekisela {havenTwo}. Uma uphendula kabi umbuzo olandelayo, usahamba nemali yesiphephelo sokugcina osidlulile.
Home.faq4Answer: Yebo — Okwakudala kuyasebenza ungaxhunyiwe. Imibuzo ngolimi lwakho igcinwa kudivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi imidlalo oyidlale ungaxhunyiwe ivumelaniswa uma usuxhumekile futhi. IMarathoni noMjaho Nesikhathi kudinga ukuxhumeka.
Home.faq5Answer: Ngena nge-Google bese udlala umdlalo wokuqhudelana weMarathoni noma woMjaho Nesikhathi. Yonke impendulo ihlolwa iseva yethu, ngakho uhlu lwabaphambili luhlala lunobulungiswa.
Home.faq6Question: Ingabe lona ngumdlalo osemthethweni wohlelo lwethelevishini?
Home.faq6Answer: Cha. Imibuzo Yosozigidi ngumdlalo ozimele owenziwe abalandeli, ogqugquzelwe uhlobo lohlelo lwemibuzo lwakudala.

classic.name: Okwakudala
classic.description: Uhlobo lwasekuqaleni: imibuzo eyishumi nanhlanu eba nzima kancane kancane, iziphephelo ezimbili, izinsizo ezine kanye nenkululeko yokuhamba nemali oyiwinile nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
classic.rules: Phendula imibuzo engu-15 ukuze uwine {top}. Iziphephelo zisemibuzweni 5 no-10. Ungahamba nganoma yisiphi isikhathi nemali osuyizuzile.

marathon.name: Imarathoni
marathon.description: Uchungechunge lwemibuzo olungapheli oluba nzima njalo ngemva kwezimpendulo ezinhlanu ezilungile. Unezinsizo ezine ozijwayele, ngayinye kanye — futhi impendulo eyodwa engalungile iqeda umdlalo.
marathon.rules: {minutes, plural, one {umzuzu ongu-#} other {imizuzu engu-#}} ngombuzo ngamunye. Izinga likhuphuka njalo ngemva kwezimpendulo ezinhlanu ezilungile. Impendulo eyodwa engalungile noma ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kuqeda umdlalo.

timeAttack.name: Umjaho Nesikhathi
timeAttack.description: Phendula imibuzo eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi siphele. Impendulo engalungile ayiwuqedi umdlalo — kodwa ikulahlekisela imizuzwana emihlanu.
timeAttack.rules: Imizuzwana engu-{seconds} ewashini. Impendulo ngayinye engalungile ikulahlekisela imizuzwana engu-{penalty}. Azikho izinsizo — isivinini kuphela.

Rules.title: Indlela yokudlala
Rules.intro: Konke okudingeka ukwazi mayelana nezindlela ezintathu zokudlala, isitebhisi semali nezinsizo.
Rules.classicBody1: Ubhekana nemibuzo eyishumi nanhlanu yokukhetha, ngamunye unezimpendulo ezine ongakhetha kuzo. Imibuzo iqala ilula bese iba nzima njengoba imali ikhula, kusukela ku-{first} embuzweni 1 kuya ku-{top} embuzweni 15.
Rules.classicBody2: Khetha impendulo, bese uyiqinisekisa njengempendulo yakho yokugcina. Uma ulungile, ukhuphuka isinyathelo esisodwa esitebhisini semali. Uma ungalungile, umdlalo uyaphela.
Rules.safeHavensBody: Imibuzo 5 no-10 iyiziphephelo. Uma usuyiphendule kahle, {havenOne} bese {havenTwo} kuyaqinisekiswa — impendulo engalungile kamuva ikubuyisela esiphephelweni sokugcina, hhayi kuziro.
Rules.walkAwayBody: Ngaphambi kokukhiya impendulo ungahamba futhi ugcine konke osukuzuzile kuze kube manje. Kwesinye isikhathi into ehlakaniphe kakhulu ukuyeka.
Rules.timerBody: Ngejubane elijwayelekile lohlelo uthola imizuzwana engu-30 emibuzweni 1–5, imizuzwana engu-45 emibuzweni 6–10, nesikhathi esingenamkhawulo emibuzweni emihlanu yokugcina. Ungashintsha noma uvale iwashi ezilungiselelweni zomdlalo.
Rules.lifelinesBody: Unezinsizo ezine, futhi ngayinye ingasetshenziswa kanye emdlalweni:
Rules.marathonBody: Umdlalo ongapheli. Imibuzo iba nzima njalo ngemva kwezimpendulo ezinhlanu ezilungile, unezinsizo ezine ngayinye kanye, futhi uthola {minutes, plural, one {umzuzu ongu-#} other {imizuzu engu-#}} ngombuzo ngamunye. Impendulo eyodwa engalungile noma ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kuqeda umdlalo, futhi amaphuzu akho yinani lezimpendulo ezilungile.
Rules.timeAttackBody: Unemizuzwana engu-{seconds} yokuphendula imibuzo eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka. Impendulo engalungile ayiwuqedi umdlalo, kodwa isusa imizuzwana engu-{penalty} ewashini. Azikho izinsizo.
Rules.rankedBody: Imidlalo yeMarathoni neyoMjaho Nesikhathi ihlale yahlulelwa iseva yethu: impendulo efanele ayifiki kudivayisi yakho ngaphambi kokuthi uphendule, futhi iwashi ligcinwa kuseva. Noma ubani angayidlala; ngena nge-Google ukuze amaphuzu akho avele ohlwini lwabaphambili.
Rules.questionsBody: Imibuzo ibhalwa ngqo ngolimi ngalunye ngumbhali wemibuzo osebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, futhi ihlolwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Cishe u-40% wayo imayelana namasiko endawo lapho kukhulunywa khona ulimi lwakho. Uma umbuzo ubonakala ungalungile, sebenzisa ethi “Bika iphutha” ngemva kokuba impendulo ivezwe.

About.title: Mayelana nomdlalo othi Imibuzo Yosozigidi
About.intro: Imibuzo Yosozigidi ngumdlalo wemibuzo wamahhala owenziwe abalandeli, ogqugquzelwe uhlelo lwethelevishini lwakudala — wakhiwe kabusha wewebhu, wamafoni, nowezilimi ezingu-80.
About.missionBody: Imidlalo eminingi yemibuzo ibhalwa ngesiNgisi bese iyahunyushwa. Sikholwa ukuthi umdlalo wemibuzo kufanele uzwakale njengasekhaya: imibuzo kufanele ibe mayelana nabantu, izindawo, izincwadi namasiko okhule nawo, kanye nomhlaba obanzi.
About.howBody: Imodeli enkulu yolimi yobuhlakani bokwenziwa ibhala wonke umbuzo ngqo ngolimi lwakho, ngamaqoqo, ilandela imithetho eqinile: impendulo eyodwa ecacile efanele, izinketho ezine ezikholakalayo, namaqiniso angaguquki kuphela. Imibuzo ihlolwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, iyagcinwa, bese inikezwa abadlali; noma imuphi umdlali angabika iphutha.
About.techBody: Imibuzo Yosozigidi iyi-app yewebhu yesimanje: ifakeka efonini noma kukhompyutha yakho, isebenza ungaxhunyiwe ngemibuzo egcinwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi ivumelanisa inqubekela phambili yakho uma usuxhumekile futhi.
About.disclaimer: Imibuzo Yosozigidi ayixhumene, ayisekelwa futhi ayihlobene nanoma yiluphi uhlelo lwethelevishini, umsakazi noma umnikazi wamalungelo.

Legal.privacyIntro: Siqoqa okuncane ngangokunokwenzeka. Leli khasi lichaza esikugcinayo nokuthi kungani.
Legal.privacyDataBody: Uma udlala ungangenanga, izilungiselelo zakho, amaphuzu namabheji kuhlala kudivayisi yakho. Uma ungena nge-Google, sigcina ikheli lakho le-imeyili, inombolo yokuhlonza ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Google, igama lakho elibonakalayo, isithombe sakho sephrofayela nemiphumela yemidlalo yakho, ukuze inqubekela phambili yakho ikulandele futhi uhlu lwabaphambili lukwazi ukubonisa igama lakho.
Legal.privacyUseBody: Imininingwane yakho isetshenziswa kuphela ukuqhuba umdlalo: ukubonisa iphrofayela yakho nezikhundla zakho ohlwini lwabaphambili kanye nokugcina inqubekela phambili yakho. Asiyithengisi futhi asabelani ngayo nabakhangisi.
Legal.privacyAnalyticsBody: Singasebenzisa izibalo zokusetshenziswa ezihlonipha ubumfihlo nemibiko yamaphutha ukuze siqonde ukuthi yiziphi izici ezisetshenziswayo nokulungisa amaphutha. Lokhu akulokothi kufake okuqukethwe yizimpendulo zakho.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: Ungashintsha igama lakho elibonakalayo nesithombe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi ungasicela ukuthi sisuse i-akhawunti yakho nayo yonke imininingwane ehambisana nayo ngokuxhumana nomenzi womdlalo.
Legal.termsIntro: Ngokudlala Imibuzo Yosozigidi uyavumelana nale migomo elula.
Legal.termsPlayBody: Dlala imidlalo yokuqhudelana ngokwethembeka. Ukudlala ngezinhlelo ezizenzakalelayo, ukusebenzisa kabi amaphutha ohlelo noma ukuphazamisa uhlu lwabaphambili kungaholela ekususweni kwemidlalo yakho.
Legal.termsContentBody: Imibuzo yenziwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi ngezinye izikhathi ingaba namaphutha. Ihlinzekelwa ukuzijabulisa kuphela. Imali yemiklomelo ayiyona yangempela — ayikho imali yangempela ehilelekile.
Legal.termsNamesBody: Ungasebenzisi amagama noma izithombe ezihlambalazayo, ezizenza abanye abantu noma ezephula amalungelo omunye umuntu. Singawashintsha noma siwasuse.

Pwa.benefit: Dlala ngesikrini esigcwele futhi ungaxhunyiwe, ngokuthinta kanye esikrinini sakho sasekhaya.

Pwa.iosStep3: Thepha “Engeza” (Add) — i-app izovela esikrinini sakho sasekhaya.

Seo.marathonDescription: Imibuzo engapheli eba nzima njalo ngemva kwezimpendulo ezinhlanu. Iphutha elilodwa liqeda umdlalo. Qhudelana ohlwini lwabaphambili lweMarathoni lomhlaba.
Seo.timeAttackTitle: Umjaho Nesikhathi — imizuzwana engu-{seconds} ubhekene newashi
Seo.timeAttackDescription: Phendula imibuzo eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka emizuzwaneni engu-{seconds}. Izimpendulo ezingalungile zikulahlekisela isikhathi. Khuphuka ohlwini lwabaphambili loMjaho Nesikhathi lomhlaba.
Seo.leaderboardTitle: Uhlu lwabaphambili — abadlali bemibuzo abahamba phambili emhlabeni
Seo.leaderboardDescription: Izikhundla zomhlaba zeMarathoni noMjaho Nesikhathi, ezihlungeka ngolimi. Sesha abadlali ubone ukuthi ubani ohamba phambili kuleli sonto.
Seo.categoriesTitle: Izigaba zemibuzo — umlando, isayensi, amafilimu, ezemidlalo nokunye
Seo.categoriesDescription: Izigaba zemibuzo eziyishumi nesithupha ezinemibuzo ebhalwe ngqo ngolimi lwakho, kusukela emlandweni womhlaba kuya emasikweni akini.
Seo.badgesDescription: Amabheji angamashumi amabili okufanele uwazuze emidlalweni yakudala, eMarathoni nakuMjaho Nesikhathi: wina isigidi, dlala nsuku zonke, dlala ngezilimi eziningi.
Seo.rulesTitle: Indlela yokudlala — imithetho, isitebhisi semali nezinsizo
Seo.rulesDescription: Imithetho egcwele yomdlalo othi Imibuzo Yosozigidi: isitebhisi semali, iziphephelo, ukuhamba nemali, izinsizo ezine, iMarathoni noMjaho Nesikhathi.
Seo.aboutDescription: Umdlalo wemibuzo wamahhala owenziwe abalandeli, onemibuzo ebhalwe ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngezilimi ezingu-80, ogqugquzelwe uhlelo lwemibuzo lwethelevishini lwakudala.
Seo.privacyDescription: Lokho Imibuzo Yosozigidi ekugcinayo, ukuthi kungani, nendlela yokukususa.
Seo.termsDescription: Imithetho elula yokudlala Imibuzo Yosozigidi ngokwethembeka.
Seo.contactDescription: Unombuzo, umbono noma uthole iphutha embuzweni? Thumela umlayezo ethimbeni lomdlalo othi Imibuzo Yosozigidi.
Seo.signInDescription: Ngena nge-Google ukuze amaphuzu akho avele ohlwini lwabaphambili futhi ugcine inqubekela phambili yakho kuyo yonke idivayisi.
